verdict.rationale: Docs describe per-end-user connected accounts with built-in auth/token storage/refresh handled by Pipedream, external_user_id scoping so agents act only on that user's credentials, and user-facing revocation of connected accounts; the live probe confirms the MCP server enforces an external user id binding before serving tools, corroborating the scoping claim. missing for 10: independent multi-tenant audit or case study showing token isolation at scale, and detail on scoped token permission granularity beyond per-account connection.
